Aladdin.prompt_ch: 阿拉丁，一个黑发棕眼的年轻男孩，皮肤被阳光晒得微黑，脸上总挂着灿烂的笑容。他穿着紫色的上衣，敞开露出胸膛，下身穿着宽松的白色长裤。
Aladdin.prompt_en: Aladdin, a young boy with black hair and brown eyes, his skin slightly tanned by the sun, always wearing a bright smile. He sports a purple open-chested shirt and loose white trousers.

Sorcerer.prompt_ch: 一个黑发黑眼的中年男子，面相奸诈阴险，瘦削的脸上留着长长的胡须。他总是穿着宽大的红色长袍，头戴一顶黑色的大臣帽子，给人一种神秘而阴险的感觉。
Sorcerer.prompt_en: A middle-aged man with black hair and dark eyes, his face thin and sinister, adorned with a long beard. He wears a large red robe and a black minister's hat, exuding a mysterious and cunning aura.

Princess.prompt_ch: 茉莉公主，一位黑发棕眼的美丽少女，古铜色的皮肤，举止优雅。她常穿着蓝色的抹胸和长裤，发箍上镶嵌着闪亮的宝石，散发出高贵的气质。
Princess.prompt_en: Princess Jasmine, a beautiful young woman with black hair and brown eyes, her skin a bronze hue, graceful in demeanor. She often wears a blue crop top and trousers, with a headband studded with sparkling gems, radiating nobility.

Genie.prompt_ch: 一个巨大的神灵，身形高大壮硕，宝蓝色的魂体，全身散发着光芒，身形酷似相扑选手。
Genie.prompt_en: A colossal spirit, towering and robust, with a sapphire-blue ethereal form that glows brightly, resembling a sumo wrestler in physique.

King.prompt_ch: 一个黑发黑眼的老年男子，身形矮小但眼神威严，留着长长的巨大的白色胡须。他总是穿着华丽的国王服饰，头戴饰有羽毛的金色帽子，给人一种威严而庄重的感觉。
King.prompt_en: An elderly man with black hair and dark eyes, short in stature but with a commanding gaze, sporting a long, voluminous white beard. He is always dressed in lavish royal attire and a gold feathered crown, exuding dignity and solemnity.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 阿拉丁在街角和朋友们玩耍，脸上挂着灿烂的笑容。
Plot Correspondence.en: Aladdin plays with his friends at a street corner, his face lit up with a bright smile.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，城市街道，热闹的氛围，街角有几个小摊贩，地上散落着一些玩具和零食包装，阳光明媚，微风轻拂
Setting Description.en: Daytime, city street, lively atmosphere, street vendors at the corner, scattered toys and snack wrappers on the ground, bright sunlight, gentle breeze

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿拉丁站在画面中央，与朋友们嬉戏，表情开心，动作活泼，地上散落着玩具和零食包装
Static Shot Description.en: Aladdin stands at the center of the frame, playing joyfully with his friends, his expression happy and movements lively, with toys and snack wrappers scattered on the ground

Plot Correspondence.ch: 一个神秘的魔法师走近阿拉丁，自称是阿拉丁失踪多年的伯父。
Plot Correspondence.en: A mysterious sorcerer approaches Aladdin, claiming to be his long-lost uncle.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，城市街道，神秘的氛围，街角的小摊贩，地上散落的玩具和零食包装，阳光被云遮挡，光线略显阴暗
Setting Description.en: Daytime, city street, mysterious atmosphere, street vendors at the corner, scattered toys and snack wrappers on the ground, sunlight obscured by clouds, lighting slightly dim

Static Shot Description.ch: 魔法师站在阿拉丁身旁，表情狡黠，阿拉丁表情疑惑，手里拿着玩具
Static Shot Description.en: The sorcerer stands beside Aladdin, his expression sly, while Aladdin looks puzzled, holding a toy in his hand

Plot Correspondence.ch: 魔法师用花言巧语骗取了阿拉丁的信任，并承诺带阿拉丁去做大生意。
Plot Correspondence.en: The sorcerer deceives Aladdin with sweet words, promising to take him on a grand venture.

Setting Description.ch: 傍晚，阿拉丁家的小屋内，温馨的氛围，简单的家具，桌上放着一盏油灯，窗外透进微弱的光线
Setting Description.en: Evening, inside Aladdin's small house, cozy atmosphere, simple furniture, an oil lamp on the table, faint light filtering through the window

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 魔法师坐在桌前，双手交叉，表情诚恳，阿拉丁站在一旁聆听，表情信任，桌上的油灯微微摇曳
Static Shot Description.en: The sorcerer sits at the table, his hands clasped, expression sincere, while Aladdin stands nearby listening, his expression trusting, the oil lamp on the table flickering slightly

Plot Correspondence.ch: 魔法师带阿拉丁来到丛林中的一块空地，念动咒语，地面裂开露出一个地道。
Plot Correspondence.en: The sorcerer leads Aladdin to a clearing in the jungle, chants a spell, and the ground splits open, revealing a tunnel.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，丛林中的空地，神秘的氛围，四周树木茂密，地面上有一块石板，光线透过树叶洒下斑驳的光影
Setting Description.en: Daytime, jungle clearing, mysterious atmosphere, dense trees surrounding, a stone slab on the ground, dappled light filtering through the leaves

Static Shot Description.ch: 魔法师站在空地中央，阿拉丁站在一旁，魔法师念动咒语，地面裂开，露出地道入口
Static Shot Description.en: The sorcerer stands at the center of the clearing, Aladdin nearby, as the sorcerer chants a spell, the ground splits open, revealing the tunnel entrance

Plot Correspondence.ch: 阿拉丁按指示完成任务，但在返回地面时，魔法师因无法立即得到油灯而大怒，将地道封闭。
Plot Correspondence.en: Aladdin follows instructions but, upon returning, the sorcerer, enraged at not receiving the lamp immediately, seals the tunnel.

Setting Description.ch: 地道内，阴暗的氛围，石壁上长满青苔，地上散落着一些碎石，远处有微弱的光线
Setting Description.en: Inside the tunnel, gloomy atmosphere, moss-covered walls, scattered rubble on the ground, faint light in the distance

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿拉丁站在地道内，表情惊恐，手中紧握旧油灯，身前的地道出口逐渐封闭，碎石掉落
Static Shot Description.en: Aladdin stands inside the tunnel, expression terrified, clutching an old oil lamp, the tunnel exit sealing before him as rubble falls

Plot Correspondence.ch: 阿拉丁绝望之际，擦拭油灯，意外召唤出灯神。
Plot Correspondence.en: In despair, Aladdin rubs the lamp and accidentally summons the Genie.

Setting Description.ch: 地道内，阴暗的氛围，石壁上长满青苔，地上散落着碎石，微弱的光线
Setting Description.en: Inside the tunnel, gloomy atmosphere, moss-covered walls, scattered rubble on the ground, faint light

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿拉丁擦拭油灯，灯神从油灯中冒出，全身散发宝蓝色光芒，阿拉丁表情震惊
Static Shot Description.en: Aladdin rubs the lamp, the Genie emerges from it, glowing sapphire-blue, Aladdin's expression shocked

Plot Correspondence.ch: 阿拉丁不再贪玩，开始认真经商。
Plot Correspondence.en: Aladdin stops fooling around and begins to focus on business.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，城市市场，繁忙的氛围，摊贩林立，人们来来往往，阳光明媚
Setting Description.en: Daytime, city market, bustling atmosphere, numerous stalls, people coming and going, bright sunlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿拉丁站在市场中央，身穿整洁的商人服饰，表情专注，与顾客交换商品和货币
Static Shot Description.en: Aladdin stands at the center of the market, dressed neatly in merchant attire, expression focused, exchanging goods and money with customers

Plot Correspondence.ch: 阿拉丁邂逅了美丽的公主，并深深爱上了她。
Plot Correspondence.en: Aladdin meets the beautiful princess and falls deeply in love with her.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，城市花园，浪漫的氛围，鲜花盛开，喷泉流水，阳光洒在花园中
Setting Description.en: Daytime, city garden, romantic atmosphere, flowers in full bloom, fountain flowing, sunlight bathing the garden

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿拉丁与公主在花园中相遇，坐在草坪上，阿拉丁表情惊艳，公主羞涩地微笑。
Static Shot Description.en: Aladdin and the princess meet in the garden, sitting on the grass, Aladdin looking awestruck, the princess smiling shyly

Plot Correspondence.ch: 阿拉丁鼓起勇气向国王提亲，国王提出苛刻条件。
Plot Correspondence.en: Aladdin gathers the courage to propose to the king, who sets harsh conditions.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，王宫大殿，庄严的氛围，金色的装饰，高大的石柱，光线透过窗户洒进大殿
Setting Description.en: Daytime, palace hall, solemn atmosphere, golden decorations, tall stone pillars, sunlight streaming through the windows

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium long shot, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿拉丁站在大殿中央，表情坚定，右手握拳放在胸口，国王坐在王座上，表情严肃，指着阿拉丁提出苛刻条件
Static Shot Description.en: Aladdin stands at the center of the hall, expression determined, his right fist over his heart, the king seated on the throne, expression stern, pointing at Aladdin as he sets the harsh conditions

Plot Correspondence.ch: 魔法师伪装成杂货商，骗取了公主的信任，用新油灯换走了神灯。
Plot Correspondence.en: The sorcerer disguises himself as a peddler, gains the princess's trust, and swaps the magic lamp for a new one.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，王宫内的小花园，宁静的氛围，鲜花盛开，石桌上放着一盏新油灯，阳光透过树叶洒下
Setting Description.en: Daytime, small palace garden, serene atmosphere, flowers in bloom, a new oil lamp on a stone table, sunlight filtering through the leaves

Static Shot Description.ch: 公主站在石桌旁，表情信任，魔法师伪装成杂货商，表情狡黠，用新油灯换走神灯
Static Shot Description.en: The princess stands by the stone table, expression trusting, the sorcerer disguised as a peddler, expression sly, swapping the magic lamp for a new one

Plot Correspondence.ch: 阿拉丁发现后，历经艰辛找到公主，并设计杀死了魔法师，夺回神灯。
Plot Correspondence.en: Aladdin discovers the deception, goes through hardships to find the princess, and schemes to kill the sorcerer, reclaiming the lamp.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚，遥远的宫殿外，紧张的氛围，四周荒凉，宫殿在月光下显得孤独，地上散落着一些战斗痕迹
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, outside a distant palace, tense atmosphere, desolate surroundings, the palace appearing lonely under the moonlight, scattered signs of battle on the ground

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿拉丁与魔法师在宫殿外对峙，阿拉丁表情愤怒地指着魔法师，魔法师表情惊恐，几欲逃走。月光洒在两人身上
Static Shot Description.en: Aladdin confronts the sorcerer outside the palace, Aladdin pointing angrily at the sorcerer, the sorcerer looking terrified and about to flee, moonlight illuminating both

Plot Correspondence.ch: 阿拉丁和公主重获幸福，他们珍惜神灯，过上了快乐的生活。
Plot Correspondence.en: Aladdin and the princess regain happiness, cherish the lamp, and live joyfully ever after.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，王宫花园，幸福的氛围，鲜花盛开，喷泉流水，阳光明媚
Setting Description.en: Daytime, palace garden, joyful atmosphere, flowers in bloom, fountain flowing, bright sunlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿拉丁与公主在花园中荡秋千，表情幸福，公主身穿华丽的宫廷礼服，阿拉丁身穿整洁的商人服饰，灯神站在一旁，表情微笑
Static Shot Description.en: Aladdin and the princess swing in the garden, expressions blissful, the princess in an elegant court dress, Aladdin in neat merchant attire, the Genie standing nearby, smiling

Plot Correspondence.ch: 几年后，阿拉丁成为国王，深受臣民爱戴。
Plot Correspondence.en: Years later, Aladdin becomes king, beloved by his subjects.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，王宫大殿，庄严的氛围，金色的装饰，高大的石柱，臣民们聚集在大殿中
Setting Description.en: Daytime, palace hall, solemn atmosphere, golden decorations, tall stone pillars, subjects gathered in the hall

Static Shot Description.ch: 阿拉丁坐在王座上，表情威严，身穿国王服饰，臣民们表情敬仰，大殿中充满欢呼声
Static Shot Description.en: Aladdin sits on the throne, expression dignified, dressed in royal attire, his subjects looking up at him admiringly, the hall filled with cheers
